name: Omnilipsi Extractor
author: daniswastaken@gmail.com
description: yt-dlp extraction backend for Omnilipsi (TikTok / IG / X / obscure sites). Listens on {{SERVER_PORT}}.

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Must match the server allocation port. Leave as {{SERVER_PORT}}.

variables.name: Auth Token
variables.description: Shared secret the Worker sends as Bearer. Must match EXTRACTOR_TOKEN secret on the Worker. Leave empty for open (not recommended if public).
